faq.q: What is the best boat charter for Ironman 2037 recovery?
faq.a: For a small group of athletes, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (Tier A) are ideal – both 12.5m, carry up to 11 passengers, and start at €749 for 2 hours. If you want more space and a free jet ski, book the Mangusta 80 (Tier B) from €4,719 for 4 hours. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from the Ironman 2037 finish line?
faq.a: The Ironman 2037 finish line is on the Marbella seafront, about 2 km from Puerto Banús – a 5-minute taxi or 20-minute walk. Our boats depart from Puerto Banús, so you can be onboard within 30 minutes of finishing the race.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs – just show up and relax.

faq.q: Can we swim in the sea after the Ironman?
faq.a: Yes – post-race swimming in the Mediterranean is safe and encouraged. We can anchor at calm coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, where the water is clear and shallow. Your skipper will choose the best spot based on weather conditions.

faq.q: How many people can we bring on the recovery charter?
faq.a: Our smallest boats (Dubhe, Mariah SX21) take up to 5 passengers, while larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 or Mangusta 80 can accommodate 12. For a typical athlete + support crew group, we recommend the Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax) or the Pershing 46 (10 pax).

faq.q: Do we need to bring anything for the boat trip?
faq.a: Just yourself, swimwear, sunscreen, and a towel. We provide all drinks, snacks, and safety gear. If you have dietary requirements, let us know when booking – we can arrange alternatives.

faq.q: How do I book a recovery boat charter for Ironman 2037?
faq.a: Book directly via WhatsApp – we respond within 1 hour. For Tier A and Tier B boats, you can also book online. Payment is by bank transfer or card. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks before the race weekend to secure your preferred boat.

faq.q: What if the weather is bad on the day?
faq.a: We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe, we reschedule or offer a full refund. The Costa del Sol enjoys 320+ sunny days per year, so bad weather is rare – but your safety comes first.

data.body_html:
You've just crossed the Ironman 2037 finish line in Marbella. Your legs are heavy, your mind is buzzing, and every muscle is calling for recovery. Forget the foam roller and ice bath – the best post-race therapy is a relaxing boat charter on the Costa del Sol. With a licensed skipper at the helm, cold drinks in hand, and the Mediterranean lapping against the hull, you can let your body and mind reset in style. Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús, just minutes from the race finish, and offers everything from 2-hour sunset cruises to full-day swim-and-snorkel adventures. Whether you're celebrating with your support crew or flying solo, we have the perfect vessel for your Ironman recovery.

Why Choose a Boat Charter for Ironman Recovery?

After 3.8 km of swimming, 180 km of cycling, and a full marathon, your body needs low-impact recovery. A boat charter delivers exactly that: gentle movement on the water, zero pounding on joints, and the therapeutic effect of sea air. Studies show that exposure to negative ions near water reduces cortisol levels and improves mood – perfect for the post-race blues. Plus, you get to explore Marbella's stunning coastline from the best seat in the house: the deck of a luxury yacht.

Our Fleet: From Compact Speedboats to Luxury Yachts

We operate a diverse fleet of 17 vessels, all based in Puerto Banús. For small groups of 2–5 athletes, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are agile and affordable. For larger parties, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers a spacious flybridge deck for sunbathing and panoramic views of La Concha mountain. If you want to treat yourself after the race, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) is the ultimate luxury recovery vessel, with multiple lounges and a crew to cater to your every need.

Pricing: Transparent, All-Inclusive Rates

We believe in honest pricing with no surprises. Here's what you can expect:

Every charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees.

Best Itineraries for Post-Race Relaxation

Our skippers know the Costa del Sol intimately. For a short recovery cruise, head west from Puerto Banús to Cala del Faro – a quiet cove with crystal-clear water, perfect for a gentle swim. For a longer trip, sail east to Cabopino, a nature reserve with sand dunes and a laid-back beach club. If you're feeling adventurous, the 8-hour charter can take you all the way to Estepona or Sotogrande, with lunch at a waterfront chiringuito. All itineraries are flexible – just tell your skipper what you need.

What to Bring (and What We Provide)

We've got you covered on drinks, snacks, and safety. You only need to bring: swimwear, sunscreen (SPF 50+ recommended), a towel, sunglasses, and a hat. If you're still sore from the race, consider bringing a light jacket – the sea breeze can be cool even in summer. We also recommend a waterproof phone pouch for photos of the stunning Marbella coastline.

Booking Your Ironman Recovery Charter

Ready to book? Browse our full fleet and then contact us via WhatsApp for availability and custom pricing. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks before the Ironman 2037 weekend to secure your preferred boat. Most charters depart from Puerto Banús, but we can arrange pick-ups from Marbella Marina or Cabopino on request. Payment is by bank transfer or card – we'll send you a confirmation within 24 hours.
